notes: This file is a human-maintained overlay for research data that TTS does not encode structurally.
Topology (path nodes, forward edges, scores) comes from src/ResearchTrackData.ttslua.
Fill costs/rewards visible on the printed board/rulebook and verify them against the physical board.
Resource keys: coin, compass, tablet, arrowhead, jewel.
Use nodeOverrides only for irregular printed spaces, such as one physical space spanning levels 4 and 5.
researchLevel is the logical level used for movement restrictions; spansLevels is descriptive UI metadata.
templeArrivalPoints is [first, second, third, fourth] and must be recorded separately for each board.
Supported research reward examples include GAIN_RESOURCE, CLAIM_ASSISTANT (silver), and UPGRADE_ASSISTANT (gold).

bridges.comment: Example entry only. Replace values after checking the board.

nodeOverrides.comment: Example only: use when one printed space spans two logical levels.

nodeRewards.comment: Silver assistant icon: player chooses one visible assistant from the supply.
Gold assistant icon: player chooses one owned silver assistant to upgrade.
